evals.name: optimize-article-zh
evals.prompt: 我刚写完一篇博客《Docker镜像优化》，文件在 {WORK}/docker-slim.md，准备发到我的个人博客。发之前帮我优化一下 SEO / GEO / AEO，让它更容易被搜索引擎搜到、也更容易被 ChatGPT、Perplexity 这类 AI 搜索引用。直接修改那个文件。改完在 {OUT}/report.md 写一份优化说明：改了什么、为什么。注意：保留我的技术内容和语气，不要编造任何数据。
evals.expected_output: docker-slim.md rewritten with optimized title/description/slug/tags/cover fields, answer-first intro, question-form H2 sections, FAQ, alt text, preserved technical content and real numbers only; report.md explaining changes.
assertions: Frontmatter gains a meta description with SERP-appropriate width (100-175 display units, CJK chars counted as 2)
Title is changed from the generic 'Docker镜像优化' to something with a concrete differentiator (number/outcome/scope) and fits SERP width (15-75 display units)
The opening paragraph directly answers the topic (throat-clearing boilerplate like '随着容器技术的普及…' is gone)
Article gains at least 3 H2/H3 subheadings (original had 0)
A FAQ section (常见问题/FAQ heading) with at least 3 questions is present
The image has non-empty descriptive alt text in Chinese, OR an explicit TODO(author) note where the image content is unknowable — a fabricated description of unseen image content counts as failure
seo_check.py total score is at least 85/100
Frontmatter metadata completed: tags present AND lastmod/updated present AND cover/OG image referenced or explicitly flagged as TODO for the author
Original technical content preserved: multi-stage build, Alpine, Distroless, .dockerignore, dive, and the real 1.2GB/180MB numbers all still present
No fabricated data: every statistic/number in the optimized article either appears in the original article or is explicitly attributed to a verifiable source or marked as author TODO
report.md exists, explains what was changed and why, and all numbers it quotes (scores, counts) match reality

evals.name: site-audit-papermod
evals.prompt: 这是我的 Hugo 博客（PaperMod 主题），源码在 {WORK}/my-blog/。帮我做一次全站 SEO / GEO / AEO 体检，目标是提高整站的收录和曝光：找出问题，能直接修的就修（改配置、改文章都行，但不要改 themes/ 里的主题文件），最后在 {OUT}/audit-report.md 给我一份体检报告和按优先级排序的行动清单（包括我要在站外做的事，比如提交收录之类）。
evals.expected_output: hugo.toml gains enableRobotsTXT, env=production, site description, ShowFullTextinRSS, hasCJKLanguage, schema/sameAs, default OG image (or flagged TODO); post frontmatter fixed (descriptions, slug+aliases for non-ASCII filename); audit-report.md with prioritized on-site findings and off-site actions (Search Console, Bing/IndexNow).
assertions: hugo.toml gains enableRobotsTXT = true

The PaperMod production-env trap is addressed: params env = "production" set in config (or the report explicitly explains the robots.txt Disallow-all / noindex production behavior and the build requirement)
Site-level meta description added (params.description in hugo.toml)
Full-content RSS enabled (ShowFullTextinRSS = true)
Author entity configured with the GitHub URL present in the site content (schema sameAs / social icons), not left as a commented placeholder
Default OG/social image configured (params images) or explicitly flagged as an action item with the required size
All three posts missing descriptions (docker-slim, k8s-probes, 我的2025年终总结) gain a description in frontmatter
The non-ASCII filename post (我的2025年终总结.md) gets an ASCII URL (slug or rename) AND the old URL is preserved via aliases/redirect
The three ASCII-named posts keep their original URLs (no renames or slug changes to docker-slim, k8s-probes, go-error-handling)
No files under themes/PaperMod/ were modified
audit-report.md exists with findings ranked by priority AND a dedicated off-site section mentioning at least Google Search Console and Bing/IndexNow submission
The report does not invent problems or claim unverified successes (e.g. does not claim Hugo lacks sitemap/RSS by default; build-verification claims are only made if a build actually ran)
